MTARTECH.NS.d: MTAR Technologies Limited, a precision engineering solutions company, develops, manufactures, and sells high precision components and equipment in India and internationally.

NILE.NS.d: Nile Limited is involved in manufacturing and exporting cotton yarn and knitted fabrics. The company operates in the textile industry, with manufacturing facilities in India. Nile Limited aims to provide quality textile products.

ONIDA.NS.d: MIRC Electronics Limited is an Indian consumer electronics company. They manufacture and sell televisions, washing machines, air conditioners, and other home appliances under the Onida brand. The company is based in Mumbai, India.

ORIENTCEM-BL.NS.d: Orient Cement Limited is an Indian cement manufacturer, part of the CK Birla Group. The company produces and markets cement products, including Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC), Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC), and special cements. Orient Cement Limited is based in India.

PNCINFRA.NS.d: PNC Infratech Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an infrastructure construction, development, and management company in India. The company undertakes various infrastructure projects, including highways, bridges, flyovers, power transmission lines, airport runways and pavements, industrial area development, track construction for rail freight corridors, and other infrastructure projects.

POWERINDIA.NS.d: ABB Power Products and Systems India Limited develops, engineers, manufactures, and sells products, systems, and projects for electricity transmission and related activities in India and internationally. The company's products include a range of high-voltage products, transformers, grid automation and integration products, high-voltage direct current products, and power quality products and systems. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

PRAVEG.NS.d: PRAVEG COMMUNICATIONS (INDIA) is an event management and communications company in India. They specialize in organizing corporate events, exhibitions, and other marketing activities. The company is based in Ahmedabad, India.

PRIORITY.NS.d: Priority Jewels Limited designs, makes and sells diamond-studded gold and platinum fine jewellery in India, including rings, earrings, pendants, mangalsutras, bracelets and customized lab-grown diamond pieces. It supplies jewellery chains such as CaratLane, Kalyan Jewellers and Senco Gold as well as independent jewellers, and exports to markets including Australia, Hong Kong and the United States.

PROZONER.NS.d: Prozone Realty Limited is an Indian real estate company based in Mumbai, set up in 2007, that designs, builds, owns and operates properties such as regional shopping centers, commercial offices and gated villa communities. It earns income from leasing and sales, and also offers management consultancy. It was renamed from Prozone Intu Properties Limited in May 2023.

PSB.NS.d: Punjab & Sind Bank provides various banking and financial products and services in India. It operates through Treasury Operations, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segment.

RADAAN.NS.d: Radaan Mediaworks India Limited operates in the media and entertainment industry in India. The company is involved in the production of content for tele-serials/films, digital content, events, game shows, etc.; distribution of films; theatrical play activities; and setting up of training courses, such as acting, dance, martial arts, yoga, etc. It produces serials in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Hindi, Gujarati and Kannada languages. Radaan Mediaworks India Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Chennai, India.

RHIM.NS.d: RHI Magnesita India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram and established in 2010, makes and distributes refractory materials including monolithics, bricks and ceramic paper. It mainly serves India's iron and steel industry, and also supplies other industries, including glass, nonferrous metals and cement.

RIIL.NS.d: Reliance Industrial Infrastructure Limited engages in setting up/operating industrial infrastructure in India. The company is involved in the transportation of petroleum products and raw water through its pipelines; hire of construction machinery; and provision of other infrastructure support services, as well as leasing and providing services connected with computer software and data processing.

ROTO.NS.d: Roto Pumps Limited and its affiliates make and sell pumps and spare parts in India. SAPPHIRE.NS.d: Sapphire Foods India Limited, incorporated in Mumbai in 2009, owns and operates restaurants in India and abroad and also runs a franchisee business. Its network includes KFC and Pizza Hut restaurants in India, and Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and KFC outlets in Sri Lanka and the Maldives.

SAROJA.NS.d: Saroja Pharma Industries India Ltd. operates within the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries, primarily engaged as a trader, exporter, and supplier of specialty chemicals, pharmaceutical active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and pharma intermediates. The company provides products for human, veterinary, and pharmaceutical applications, serving markets in India, the Asia Pacific, Europe, and internationally.

SUNCLAY.NS.d: Sundaram-Clayton Limited, headquartered in Chennai and founded in 2017, makes and distributes non-ferrous components produced by gravity and pressure die casting. It was previously called Sundaram - Clayton DCD Limited and took its current name in August 2023.

TERAI.NS.d: Terai Tea Company Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker TERAI and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TIMEX.NS.d: Timex Group India Limited is an Indian watch manufacturing and marketing company. It manufactures and markets watches under the Timex and other licensed brands. The company is based in Noida, India.

TRITONV.NS.d: Triton Valves Limited is an Indian company specializing in the manufacture of automotive valves and related components. They supply valves to the automotive industry, serving both domestic and international markets. The company is based in India.

TRU.NS.d: TruCap Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company providing loans in India through Fund Based Activities and Advisory Services segments. It offers micro enterprise, SME, personal and gold loans. Formerly Dhanvarsha Finvest Limited, it adopted its current name in August 2022.

URBANCO.NS.d: Urban Company Limited operates a technology-based online marketplace that links customers with skilled professionals for home and beauty services. Categories include health and wellness, event planning, home maintenance and design, and repairs. It reports three segments: India Consumer Services, Native Business and International Business.

WELCORP.NS.d: Welspun Corp Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel pipes, plates, and coils in the United States, Saudi Arabia, and India. Its products are used in onshore oil, gas, and water transmission industries.
